correctness.rationale: Reproducible exhaustive face enumeration agrees between two independent algorithms; signed augmented chain cancellation via unit pivots is unimodular, and 121x541 residual rank-one boundary has gcd invariant nine. Primitive column and row factors establish the unique Smith invariant 9; last quotient chain groups yield H2=Z/9 and H3=Z^120. Independent modular ranks over 2,3,5 confirm the characteristic-three difference; full verified checker and observed output included.

value.rationale: The seven-by-seven periodic queen placement complex is a canonical finite constraint complex attached to an old toroidal chess problem. Exact integral homology of ALL partial placements, especially order-nine torsion not recoverable from field ranks or counts of 28 maximal configurations, is a structurally interesting invariant of a natural object and potentially relevant to chessboard-torsion topology. Does not rely on an arbitrary slice or pretend an infinite family is classified.
